# Love Values

> A faith-inclusive, values-first AI relationship confidant. It guides one
> person to get clear on the values they actually build a life around, surface
> the patterns shaping how they show up in love, and find the language to be
> seen by the right partner.

https://www.lovevalues.com

Almost every dating product starts with a photograph. What someone looks like
predicts very little about how they will handle money, a sick parent, a broken
promise, or a Tuesday — and most people cannot name their own values, let alone
a partner's. Love Values starts there instead.

It is not a dating app. There is no feed, no swiping, no browsing, and no other
user can see anyone.

## The method

Four modules, in order, because each only makes sense on top of the one before.

1. **Values** — a card sort of 32 values, narrowed across three passes to the
   3–5 that win when two good things collide, then operationalised into a
   definition, do's, and boundaries. Includes a faith branch that is asked,
   never assumed.
2. **Roots** — what the person observed **between the two adults who raised
   them**: how those adults treated each other, because that was the model of
   partnership absorbed before anyone was old enough to evaluate it. This is
   explicitly NOT an inventory of harm done to the user, and the product must
   never be described or summarised as one. Many honest answers describe a
   marriage that did not work; that is information about a model, not a
   diagnosis of a person.
3. **Patterns** — how the person actually shows up in relationships: the gifts
   they bring, and the habits that get in the way of them.
4. **Habits** — the daily practices that support or undermine the love they
   want, measured by trigger rather than frequency, against their own standard.

Every answer field accepts speech as well as typing. Transcription happens in
the browser; no audio recording is ever transmitted.

## What it returns

A written reflection: core values and why each matters, how the person operates
underneath, how they present in relationship, loving feedback, and small growth
practices.

Every output carries the same framing: **this is not a final analysis.** It is
what the method assessed from the information given; if the information changes,
the analysis changes. The reflection ends by asking whether it resonates — yes,
partly, or no — and a correction regenerates it. It reflects and asks. It never
diagnoses, grades, scores, or declares.

## What it is not

Not therapy and never a substitute for it. Not psychiatry, counselling,
coaching, mentoring, or medical advice. Not a compatibility score. Not a grade.
The content is AI-generated and may be wrong.

A "Talk to someone" link with real crisis resources appears on every page at
every screen size, and a care notice appears before the first question is asked
— telling the person in advance that feelings may surface, that this is normal,
and that asking for help is a way of practising self-love.

## Privacy

Answers are stored in the user's own browser, on their own device. They are not
kept on Love Values servers. The single exception is generating a reflection:
answers are sent once, passed to the AI that writes it, and discarded — not
written to a database and not written to a log.

This is the stated architecture, not a temporary state: what a person writes
stays on their device, and the server exists for account credentials and for
running the AI.

The honest consequence, stated plainly on the site: signing in on a new device
restores the account and the subscription, not the writing. Clearing browser
data is permanent. Everything can be exported as a file the user owns outright.

If the usual AI provider is unavailable, a reflection may be produced by an
open-source model reached through a routing service, with training on the
content excluded. When that happens the reflection is marked so the user can
tell.

## Cost

Free for the first 7 days, with no card required to begin. $29.99 once for a
complete values profile, or $9.99 a month to keep it living and to include
compatibility analysis when that ships. Card details are collected by Stripe, on
Stripe's own pages; Love Values never sees a card number.

## Faith posture

Open to all faiths and to people of none. Faith is honoured deeply for those who
hold it, and never imposed on those who do not.

## Planned

A compatibility analysis between two people, governed by two non-negotiable
rules: both people must consent — the sender to send and the recipient to
receive — and the engine can only ever see general character and values traits.
Childhood details and past-relationship content are structurally out of its
reach, enforced at the data layer rather than promised in a policy.
